title: Update repo profile for the dev+main promotion gate
summary: Step 5 of 5 in the user-approved main-branch migration. Corrects CLAUDE.md's repository-profile section (outside the digest-checked operating block, safe to edit freely) to match reality after OMARK-29 through OMARK-32: main exists, dev stays default (matching every sibling), opum-workflow's content is gated behind main, and -- named precisely rather than overstated -- marketplace.json's own listing is not gated, still resolved from whatever the marketplace clone's dev checkout holds. Verified with opum-agent (OPAG-69) before writing this: the asymmetry is real (confirmed by diffing the local clone's marketplace.json against dev, byte-identical), but the version-bump mechanism sits on the GATED side, not the ungated side as first reasoned -- version lives solely in opum-workflow's own plugin.json, which is content, fetched from main after the repoint.

acceptanceCriteria.text: "No main branch, by decision" bullet under Constraints and couplings is replaced with the actual model: main exists, dev stays default, and what specifically is and is not gated by the promotion.

"What other repositories read from here" section's source description (currently 'source "./" ') and its 'resolves against dev rather than a pinned tag' claim are both corrected to name the explicit ref: main form and its actual current state.
The marketplace.json-listing asymmetry is stated precisely -- gated content vs. ungated listing -- not glossed over as 'now has a gate' the way opum-agent flagged as the exact overstatement risk.
CLAUDE.md's own historical line about opum-marketplace joining 'as the eighth repository' is untouched -- still a dated fact about a past event, unaffected by this repo's branch model changing.

implementationNotes: Digest confirmed unchanged (4cbdcba163ba318f) before and after -- the profile section sits well below opum:fleet-operating:end, never at risk, but checked rather than assumed given the orchestrator's explicit 'do not touch the operating block' instruction from earlier today. Folded in the OPAG-65 correction directly: opum-agent's point 2 traced to reading 'the manifest' as marketplace.json when it meant plugin.json -- recorded which file actually carries the version so the next reader does not re-make the same substitution.
finalSummary: CLAUDE.md's profile section corrected: main branch model documented precisely, marketplace.json listing-vs-content asymmetry stated explicitly rather than glossed over. Operating block digest unaffected, verified before and after.
